headline.title: Anthropic’s relationship with the Trump administration seems to be thawing
headline.summary: Anthropic continues to engage in discussions with senior officials from the Trump administration, despite being identified as a supply-chain risk by the Pentagon. This indicates a potential thawing of their previously strained relationship.

articles.title: It Takes 2 Minutes to Hack the EU’s New Age-Verification App
articles.summary: A recent report reveals that the European Union's new age-verification app can be hacked in just two minutes, raising concerns about its security. Additionally, the article highlights significant data breaches at a gym chain and a hotel giant, along with a disruptive DDoS attack targeting Bluesky.

articles.title: AI chip startup Cerebras files for IPO
articles.summary: AI chip startup Cerebras has filed for an initial public offering (IPO) following significant partnerships, including an agreement with Amazon Web Services to utilize its chips in data centers and a reported $10 billion deal with OpenAI. The IPO filing marks a key step for the company as it seeks to expand its market presence.

articles.title: The App Store is booming again, and AI may be why
articles.summary: New data from Appfigures indicates a significant increase in app launches in 2026, potentially driven by advancements in AI tools. This resurgence suggests that AI may be playing a crucial role in revitalizing the mobile software market.

articles.title: Schematik Is ‘Cursor for Hardware.’ Anthropic Wants In
articles.summary: Schematik is a new program designed to assist users in coding for physical devices, likened to a "cursor for hardware." Anthropic has expressed interest in this technology, which aims to simplify the coding process while ensuring safety.

articles.title: 7 ways to travel smarter this summer, with help from Google
articles.summary: The article outlines seven strategies for smarter summer travel using Google tools, including tips for planning, navigation, and finding local attractions. It emphasizes leveraging technology to enhance the travel experience and make the most of summer adventures.

articles.title: US-sanctioned currency exchange says $15 million heist done by "unfriendly states"
articles.summary: Grinex, a US-sanctioned currency exchange, reported a $15 million heist, attributing the attack to resources that it claims are only accessible to "unfriendly states." The exchange's statement highlights concerns over the capabilities of state-sponsored hacking in the cryptocurrency sector.

articles.title: Sam Altman’s project World looks to scale its human verification empire. First stop: Tinder.
articles.summary: Sam Altman's project World is aiming to expand its human verification services through partnerships, starting with Tinder. The initiative focuses on its Orb-centered anonymous verification system to enhance user safety and trust on the platform.

articles.title: Sources: Cursor in talks to raise $2B+ at $50B valuation as enterprise growth surges
articles.summary: Cursor is in discussions to raise over $2 billion at a valuation of $50 billion, driven by significant growth in its enterprise segment. The funding round is expected to be led by returning investors a16z and Thrive.

articles.title: OpenAI’s former Sora boss is leaving
articles.summary: Bill Peebles, the leader of OpenAI's Sora video generation tool, has announced his departure from the company following its decision to discontinue the Sora project. This change is part of OpenAI's broader strategy to refocus its efforts and avoid distractions.

articles.title: Should you stare into Sam Altman’s orb before your next date?
articles.summary: Tinder is introducing a feature that allows users to earn five free boosts by verifying their identity through a facial-scanning orb developed by World, a company co-founded by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. This initiative aims to enhance user authenticity on the platform.

articles.title: Anthropic’s new cybersecurity model could get it back in the government’s good graces
articles.summary: Anthropic's new cybersecurity model, Claude Mythos Preview, may help improve its relationship with the Trump administration, which has previously criticized the company as a national security threat. The model's focus on cybersecurity could potentially address some of the government's concerns regarding AI safety and security.
